conviction_note: The quarter's top line is pre-released and the stock has already traded on it (-0.88% on 2 Nov). What is new tonight is the first guide on a franchised model, which loses about $40m a year of restaurant-level profit (pro forma 8-K) and so should mechanically cut the $70-73m adj. EBITDA guide by roughly $13-15m for FY26 while the comps guide likely rises. Against that: a short base of 9.8% of shares outstanding (9.7 days to cover), a -10.7% slide in five sessions against IWM -3.9%, and three consecutive prints bought +18% to +33%. The findings sum to +0.4 and the scaled number is +0.5 (p_up 52, abs move 13). The two agree. Both say the sign is close to a coin flip on a large move.

findings.finding: The adj. EBITDA guide ($70-73m, excluding refranchising) should come down mechanically under the franchised model. The pro forma 8-K shows the sold units earned $63.6m restaurant-level profit in FY25 ($394.7m revenue less $331.2m costs) against $23.0m franchise revenue, about $40m a year net. On the ~18 weeks after the ~1 Sep closings that is a ~$13-15m FY26 cut, before G&A savings. Pro forma YTD-26 operating income goes from +$11.7m reported to -$6.5m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior franchised-model guide exists. The last guide update (reaffirmation, Q2) was bought +21%. The FY25 guide raise in Nov 2025 (Q3 FY25) was followed by -6.38% (baseline, 2025-11-10).
findings.why_not_priced: The pro forma has been public since 1 Sep, yet the stock rose about 20% in October and the street's FY26 revenue ($1.17bn) and FY27 EPS (+$0.28) look as if they do not net out ~$140m of FY26 sold-unit revenue. That suggests the three-analyst bar has not been rebased. If it had, the revenue estimate would sit near $1.08bn.
findings.independence: The company's own statement that its guidance excluded refranchising and would be updated (Q2 release, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1171759/000162828026056187/exhibit991q2-2026.htm). findings.finding: The balance sheet is reset. About $89.4m of proceeds went to debt (borrowings were $167.2m at 12 Jul), and a new 5-year $115m JPMorgan-led facility ($90m term loan, $25m revolver) prices at SOFR+325, against the ~11.5-12% rate the pro forma used for the old debt. The pro forma puts interest savings at about $11.5m a year. Amortisation is 5% a year.

The overhang can only show up as supply after the print, so any day-one effect depends on whether they sell into a pop. If the market had priced heavy selling, the stock would not have rallied 10% on 28 Oct.

findings.finding: Beef inflation is a margin headwind for a burger chain. Datassential (Mar 2026) puts beef costs +32% since 2023 against burger menu prices +14%, and Toast puts median burger prices only +2% YoY through Sep 2026. Red Robin's +5.6% check suggests it priced to offset, but the FY restaurant-margin guide of ~13% is at risk. The company has not confirmed this.

baseline_tension: The baseline gives no skew (null) and a call-heavy OI ratio of 0.19. The -10.7% five-day run-down and the history of large up-moves lean up, while the mechanical EBITDA reset and the activist overhang lean down. The evidence offsets, which is why p_up is near 50 even though the expected absolute move is large.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6 (bar single-source or stale): revenue-vs-consensus finding capped from -1.0 to -0.5. Adj. EPS finding trimmed from +0.5 to +0.3, because the two agreeing sources likely share one feed.
Lesson 7 (crowded short shrinks negatives; SI 9.8% of shares outstanding, 9.7 days to cover): EBITDA guide-reset finding from -2.5 to -2.0, activist-overhang finding from -1.5 to -1.0.
Lesson 5 (an unexplained drawdown is worth little; a proxy is small): price-path finding from +1.0 to +0.3, beef-inflation proxy from -0.5 to -0.3.
Lesson 2 (one-offs as one-offs): GAAP sale-gain finding from +0.2 to +0.1.
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): answered as a refinancing of costlier debt after an asset sale, a modest positive, trimmed from +0.5 to +0.3 because the October rally priced most of it.

Lessons 1 and 8 left standing: reaction-history (+1.0) and short-interest (+1.0) findings unchanged. abs_move_pct kept at 13 and not shrunk. p_up moved from 50 to 52 because the negatives were shrunk for the crowded short.
